q: For me, I now waddle at nearly 28 weeks. I thought that came later and was due to weight. Had no idea about PGP and the impact it would bring. I was (and of course will be again) strong, active and while no athlete, fit/healthy. Gym is hard now and had to massively adapt.
cx: UK, nearly 28 weeks, asking what changes surprised others.

q: And why does no one tell you about the congestion?! Been there since about 8 weeks. Its amazing what you adapt to, but the snoring is real! Poor hubby.
Considering so many people have it in the group, I'm surprised PGP isn't commonly known.
cx: Same author after many replies named pelvic pain.

q: Everyone around me keeps saying that the second trimester is going to be this magical switch that makes life so much better.. Maybe I’m being impatient (my partner definitely thinks so)

It’s been so long now where my boyfriend does 90% the cleaning and the cooking, I just sit/lay on the couch feeling guilty and useless. […] I still wfh 4 days a week so at least there’s that, but being so exhausted is starting to affect my confidence quite a lot.
I started reading Reddit pregnancy posts a few weeks ago, they’re so so helpful 💚

Whilst my partner gets to carry on eating with enjoyment no nausea gets to have a tipple if they fancy it, no judgement. Meanwhile I'm here wretching my guts out, crying my eyes out because I feel like a failure and a horrible mum to be coz apparently this is the best time of my life but I hate it...
cx: UK, 35, always wanted a baby; post titled 'Pregnancy is overrated'.

q: My husband: you look sooooo pregnant! Me: \*bursts into hysterical tears\* Husband: Noooo I meant that as a good thing!!!
cx: 7.5 weeks, already out of her clothes.

q: I went to Loft the other day & bought some super soft Lou Grey clothing (40% off in store right now & soooo soft - 10/10 recommend!) I had to buy size large - 8 weeks ago I was wearing extra small.
this has me feeling like I need to enter a dark cave by myself for the next 1.5 months and emerge with my baby once pregnancy is over.
cx: 33 weeks, crying fits; husband supportive but worn down.

q: Previously, I have read that even non-alcoholic drinks have up to 0.5% alcohol and are not recommended in pregnancy, so I have avoided even those. […] Of course I just had my 12 week appointment literally hours before going to the store and seeing this, otherwise I would have asked my OBGYN then.
cx: 12 weeks, found a 0.0% beer and wants a second opinion.

q: I’m not looking for medical clearance from Reddit, don't worry. I’m more curious about real-life experiences from people who have traveled internationally this late in pregnancy
cx: US first-time mother at 20 weeks; family trip to Italy would fall at 33-34 weeks.

q: I know it’s so hard when you’re searching for something in a Reddit post and the OP never shares what the outcome was. I wanted it to be a sense of relief/hope for others going through a similar situation!
cx: Came back days later to post how her early scare turned out.

q: I feel like my family is selfish and don’t care for me as much as I see other families go out of their way for people. […] I guess I feel isolated because I don’t have anyone to lean on unless it’s my partner.
cx: UK; has cut contact with a sister who gossips about her pregnancy.

q: adapting to being off work for more than a week for the first time in my adult life, no longer defining myself largely by my career and usefulness as an employee, seeing baby care as my only job for the next few month
cx: Two weeks after her first birth, listing what she feels.

q: wanting to share baby with family but also keep him to myself and avoid the social situations of having company
guilt about all the chores my husband is doing (I’m lucky he has solid leave) even though I am recovering from a c section and heart complications while feeding round the clock
she's really excited for me to experience a true element of womanhood and be a mom *while* I'm pregnant
cx: A trans man, 14 weeks, on his mother's reaction.

q: it appears that due to the universal phenomenon of pregnant bodies being on display and subject to public opinion, all bets are off!
